types.description: Harmony XB4 selector switch head, long handle, black, 3-position ± 45°, spring return from right to center — head only (no contact block)

document.title: Harmony XB4 metal control and signaling units — catalog (DIA5ED2121212EN)
document.pages: Catalog p.55 (physical PDF page 57), 'Selector switches with long handle', Heads only — ZB4BJ8; contact-body reference p.24 / body-contact assemblies p.74

modelingNotes: ZB4BJ8 is listed under 'Heads only' on catalog p.55: long handle, black, 3-position ± 45°, spring return from right to center (weight 0.040/0.088 kg/lb). The position scheme was visually confirmed on the rendered page: the right position spring-returns to centre, matching source notation '1-0<-2 45dgr'.
Manufacturer catalog spells the reference 'ZB4BJ8' with no hyphen; the source 'ZB4-BJ8' carries only a presentation hyphen. Identity matches; expectedOrderNumber 'ZB4-BJ8' is retained per the job.

This is a mechanical actuator (head) only. It has no contact block, no NO/NC contacts, no lamp/LED, no supply/return, no signal/communication and no documented PE terminal. Hence zero electrical terminals and zero circuit functions.

Contacts are a separately ordered body. Catalog p.55 footnote (1): the sequence of contacts constituting the body (fixing collar + contact) is associated with the head but ordered separately (fixing collar ZB4BZ10x + contact blocks; complete unit e.g. ZB4BZ103 + ZB4BJ3 = XB4BJ33). No contact numbering (e.g. 11-12/13-14) is imported into this head.

The metal head's bonding/attachment through the panel and fixing collar is not documented as a terminal on this reference and is not asserted as an installed bond. Coverage is therefore 'partial' with zero documented terminals.

Neighbouring long-handle heads are kept distinct: ZB4BJ7 = spring return from left to center; ZB4BJ5 = spring return to center (both sides); ZB4BJ3 = 3-position stay put. ZB4BJ8 is specifically right-to-centre spring return.
The OPERATOR connectorPort is a mechanical descriptor only (actuator/mounting interface); it declares no electrical pins and manufactures no continuity.

connectionCoverage.notes: Selector switch head (operator) only. Zero documented electrical terminals: contacts belong to a separately ordered body (fixing collar ZB4BZ10x + contact blocks), and the metal-head panel/collar bonding interface is not documented at a terminal level. Both are outside this head's documented scope.
